steps.summary: Simulated call Freya Marvellen. Yes, I cannot start travelling before 12:00 on 22 Oct, Berlin time, which is the same as local time in Hamburg. input.text: The driver says they cannot start travelling before 12:00 on 22 Oct Berlin time, so they cannot make the Leipzig pickup slot (22 Oct 11:00–12:00 Berlin time). They confirmed this by phone today.

The driver's own rough guess is that they could reach Leipzig around 16:00–17:00 Berlin time on 22 Oct at the earliest. They haven't checked connections. They could take a pickup around 17:00 or later on 22 Oct, but say the morning of 23 Oct is safer for them.
The driver has no travel booked and there are no quotes on file. There is also no tracking for this order.

The buyer was promised delivery in Cologne on 23 Oct 13:00–15:00 Berlin time. A pickup on 23 Oct morning would put that at risk, because Leipzig to Cologne is roughly 5–6 hours by road (my own estimate). A pickup on 22 Oct around 17:00 would still leave time to meet it. The pickup contact Lena Alderfield and access at the pickup site are still unconfirmed.
